defects.claim: An outstanding clipboard read resolving after a newer condition edit (or after a later paste) overwrites that edit with its stale result
defects.scenario: Click Paste while readText is pending, then edit a condition row; when the read resolves it replaces the condition, discarding the edit; two pastes resolving out of order do the same
defects.cause: async paste callback not guarded against staleness

defects.claim: Copy reports success for conditions with non-finite numeric values that JSON.stringify writes as null, so Paste rejects them or changes their meaning
defects.scenario: Copy a condition with above = Infinity; copy succeeds, Paste rejects it because an ordering bound must be a number; an equality comparison with Infinity pastes as a null comparison
defects.cause: validator permits non-finite numbers JSON cannot encode
